standard_prerequisites.use: Inverse exponent is a subordinator exponent and its Levy measure is the excursion lifetime measure. The PDE and resulting inverse-integral-time Laplace formula remain local obligations.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fubini, dominated convergence and Laplace inversion
standard_prerequisites.reference: Standard real analysis and uniqueness of Laplace transforms
standard_prerequisites.use: Basic exchange and inversion tools only; source proves relevant integrability, mixed derivatives and initial-value decomposition.

core_obligations: Relate the inverse-integral-time law to the inverse Laplace exponent of an associated spectrally negative Levy process, including finite-activity initial mass.
Derive the mixed PDE for the weighted transform using time change and the strong Markov property, retaining the required local regularity argument.
Solve the Laplace-in-time first-order equation and invert it to obtain the exact Levy-measure integral for all permitted times and transform parameters.
